DAT-01.sentence: Databases use encryption at rest with AES-256, and disk encryption for file storage is on the roadmap.

DAT-02.sentence: All customer traffic uses encryption in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher, and HTTPS is enforced on every public endpoint.

DAT-04.sentence: A privacy programme exists and GDPR compliance work is in progress, with a data processing agreement drafted for some customers.

DAT-05.sentence: Point-in-time recovery is available for production databases, and backup encryption is applied to every copy.

GOV-01.sentence: A written security policy covers all staff, and management approval is renewed at each annual policy review.

GOV-02.sentence: The Chief Information Security Officer is accountable for information security and leads a dedicated security team.

IAM-01.sentence: Access to systems and customer data follows an access control policy based on least privilege and role-based access.

IAM-02.sentence: Multi-factor authentication is not enforced for staff accounts, and two-factor sign-in is optional.

IAM-03.sentence: Administrator accounts are restricted for most systems, and privileged access management tooling is being rolled out.

OPS-01.sentence: Logging is centralised for production systems, and security monitoring is in progress for the rest.

OPS-02.sentence: Vulnerability scanning is not performed, and there is no formal patch management process.

OPS-04.sentence: Production runs in a dedicated VPC with network segmentation, and a firewall controls every inbound connection.

PEO-01.sentence: Security awareness training is not performed, and no phishing simulation is run.

RES-02.sentence: The company does not commit to notify customers of a data breach within a set time.

RES-03.sentence: A disaster recovery plan exists with an RTO target, and a business continuity test is planned.

SDL-01.sentence: A secure development lifecycle is not in place, and code review is not performed for most changes.

TPR-02.sentence: The in-scope services hold a current certification, and an annual independent audit renews it.
